content.raw:
Your Practical Guide to Homesteading, Survival Preparedness & Self-Reliant Living

Honest guides, tested product reviews, and real-world advice from a mom who traded suburban life for 12 acres — and never looked back.

Written by Sarah Kate Wilder • Mom of 3 • Homesteader since 2021

What We Cover

Homesteading & Gardening

From starting a survival garden to raising backyard chickens — the essential skills for growing your own food and living off the land.

25 Essential Homesteading Skills →

Survival & Emergency Preparedness

Be ready for anything. Bug out bags, emergency food, water purification, and medical preparedness guides.

Emergency Food Prep Guide →

Off-Grid Living

Solar power systems, wood stoves, rainwater collection, and building a life that doesn't depend on the grid.

Off-Grid Solar for Beginners →

Natural Health & Wellness

Take control of your health naturally. Herbal remedies, natural supplements, and self-reliant wellness.

Natural Health Guide →

Food Preservation

Canning, dehydrating, freeze-drying, and fermenting — preserve your harvest and build a year-round food supply.

How to Can Food at Home →

Raising Livestock

Chickens, goats, bees, and more. Practical guides for beginners who want to raise their own animals.

Raising Chickens Guide →

Natural GLP-3 for Weight Management

Looking for a natural alternative to GLP-1 injections like Ozempic? GLP-3 supplements support your body's own appetite regulation — no prescriptions, no needles.

Read the Complete GLP-3 Guide →

Honest Product Reviews & Buying Guides

  4. Off-Grid Solar Power for Beginners
  5. How to Can Food at Home: Beginner's Guide

More From the Homestead

GLP-3 Deep Dive

Our complete research library on natural GLP-3 supplements — how they work, side effects, comparisons, and where to buy.

What Is GLP-3? →
Side Effects Guide →
GLP-1 vs GLP-3 →

Medical Preparedness

When help isn't coming, you need to be ready. Build your medical kit, learn first aid, and know your natural remedies.

Medical Prep Guide →
Natural Remedies →
Survival Medicine Books →

Food Independence

Grow it, preserve it, store it. Everything you need to feed your family without depending on grocery stores.

Long-Term Food Storage →
Best Canning Supplies →
Canned vs Dehydrated →
Stay Prepared. Stay Free.
Explore our full blog for 80+ guides, reviews, and how-tos on self-reliant living.
